summary.result: In this study, applicability of graph theory to figure out optimum layout of irrigation pipeline networks was evaluated.
summary.background: Installation of irrigation pipeline systems is increasing since the systems have several advantages compared to open channel systems.
summary.method: To achieve economic design of pipeline networks, the layout should meet several conditions such as shortest path, maximum flow, and least cost.
